administration.typed_definition_issue_note: OPEN is an informational issue-state readback, not a scientific status.

scope.purpose: Prospective observation/calibration for one context; no hardware, data, certificate, executable map or physical ID.

definitions.POC1-TRACE: Immutable raw trace plus derived feature.
definitions.POC1-WAVE-SEPARATION: Independent directional or cold force/velocity route.

observation.raw_equality: Literal complete sample equality, including time/channel/flags/context.

trace.raw_retention: Retain immutable raw bytes; no overwrite by corrected data.
trace.window_rule: Freeze windows/weights before validation; no peak or target-based selection.
trace.data_quality_rule: Invalid/clipped/missing samples retain flags; never fabricated zero or silent omission.

sensor_calibration.mathematical_form: If certified affine: raw_i=offset_i+polarity_i*gain_i*model_i+noise_i, gain_i>0, polarity_i in {-1,+1}; corrected_i=polarity_i*(raw_i-offset_i)/gain_i. Otherwise require an independent dynamic transfer.
sensor_calibration.independence: Never fit sensor gain/sign/phase/offset/window through the tested g-law. Relative gain confounds b/a; polarity flip exchanges g and 4/g.
sensor_calibration.baseline_boundary: Electronics zero is not zero pair, cold a=0, empty reservoir or reset.

decoder_scales.no_unit_identification: Symbol definitions are not physical IDs/SI certificates; sensor calibration and decoder scales are distinct.
decoder_scales.proposed_forms: Proposed A0 [m], tau [s], E_star [J]: V0=A0/tau, F0=E_star/A0, Z0=E_star*tau/A0^2; V=V0*p, F=F0*f, Z=Z0*g. Here p=(w-u)/2 is a centered discrete coefficient, not an interval mean. Values and physical dictionary unresolved.

wave_separation.rule: Separation reference must be independent, not fitted Z(g).
wave_separation.circularity_witness: Using Z=Z0*g in r=(F-ZV)/(F+ZV)=(2-g)/(2+g) leaves F=2*Z0*V; g cancels.
wave_separation.alternatives: Routes A/B below remain unselected; each needs its own physical certificates.

routes.A: Independent signed directional readout, independent Z_ref and independently justified relation to model Z; no trial Z(g).
routes.B: COLD_FORCE_VELOCITY: independently calibrated F,V with certified a=0 and V excluding zero give Z=-F/V, g=(-F/V)/Z0 with independent Z0. No directional wave separation required; validate one frozen response on held-out records.

preparation_and_cut.model_convention: P0 postkick; transition t available at n0+t+1. Counter labels are not physical time.

context.parameter_rule: Freeze settings/provenance before comparison; estimates label a conditional context, not a derivation from U.
context.changed_context_rule: Changed settings need new context or frozen drift rule; no held-out refit.

model_identification.estimator_form: For independently calibrated warm signed amplitudes A!=0, r=B/A and g=2*(1-r)/(1+r), valid for -1<r<1.
model_identification.output: g-region with full data/calibration/context/budget provenance; not physical ID.
model_identification.rationality_boundary: Finite estimates do not prove rational g. A rational nominal g0 needs predeclared selection and model-error budget; no target snapping.
model_identification.allowed_fit_inputs: Designated identification data only; no Born targets, held-out data or unknown sensor gain/phase.
model_identification.route_B_form: g=(-F/V)/Z0; independent cold certificate, F/V calibration, Z0 and V-region excluding zero required.

held_out_validation.law: Freeze route-specific predictions/g-region; cold e0 also needs its source and scale certificate.
held_out_validation.no_closure: Compatibility is not exact equality, realization, family completeness, occurrence, Born or owner closure.

measured_work.orientation: Positive work into the wave; physical channel polarity mapping remains unresolved.
measured_work.continuous_work: W=integral effort(time)*flow(time) dtime on the declared interval.
measured_work.model_work: Single port E_star*g*(a^2-b^2); generally E_star*sum_x Gamma_x*(a_x^2-b_x^2).
measured_work.bridge_warning: Integral of product need not equal duration times product of means; bound phase/bandwidth/intra-cut variation.
measured_work.non_circularity: g*b^2 from the same b is not independently observed heat. Heat, tape and q*count+remainder are one store.

uncertainty_and_thresholds.dependence_rule: Justified joint/worst-case regions; no assumed Gaussian independence or missing-error-zero convention.
uncertainty_and_thresholds.ill_conditioning: An A interval containing 0 can prevent a finite ratio bound; reaching r=-1 can prevent a finite upper bound for g. Unresolved relative polarity prevents branch-resolved identification but may leave a bounded union: retain both admissible branches or apply the predeclared polarity STOP gate.
uncertainty_and_thresholds.threshold_rule: Resolve floor(heat/q) only if the entire joint region yields one integer; otherwise retain ambiguity.
uncertainty_and_thresholds.event_scope: Zero/multiple crossings per batch; one accounting EventRecord per step. No probability/L6 lift.

diagnostics.warm_plan: Independent zero pair; freeze zero, paired +/-A and multiple amplitudes, ordering, windows and repetitions in calibrated range. Sensor/model data remain separate.
diagnostics.warm_formula: w=4*g*A/(2+g), b=(2-g)*A/(2+g); g symbolic, not assigned.
diagnostics.cold_plan: Independent signed e0=(1,0,0,0), RRP1 five-site P0=(0,Sz), origin g>0.
diagnostics.cold_formula: h=1421/1620; first w0=2*h/(2+g), b0=-h/(2+g), deposited model energy g*h^2/(2+g)^2.
diagnostics.ambiguity: Cold eta=deposit/h^2 is invariant g<->4/g and has maximum 1/8 at g=2. Unknown warm polarity restores the reciprocal ambiguity. No Born-based branch choice.

data_custody.no_fixtures: No synthetic data, hardware names, tolerances or calibrations.
data_custody.hash_timing: Hash existing code, reference inputs and calibration artifacts before the test pin. Future raw-data hashes are recorded after acquisition in the custody/readback manifest; no prehash of unacquired data is required.

readiness.STOP: Missing field/certificate/data, overlapping validation, source/cut mismatch, circular fit, invalid trace, missing budget or integrity.
readiness.limited_rejection: Reject only the frozen law/dictionary/context once physical and integrity premises are supplied.
readiness.unchanged: Owner O, realization, reset, family, terminality, occurrence, Born and L6 remain unresolved.

external_primary_references.title: Kurokawa (1965), Power Waves and the Scattering Matrix
external_primary_references.use: Reference-impedance conventions, not TWIST-J physical identification.

external_primary_references.title: NIST dynamic calibration article
external_primary_references.use: Dynamic gain/phase calibration, not a supplied sensor certificate.
